reviews.title: Love the clarity, but no Height adj
reviews.comment: This is an upgrade from an older HP model that ran on display port and was a 1080i model. Much better image quality and better color rendition. Height as delivered is OK, but I should have gone for adjustablity. Base is stable and bezel is minimal. Power button is located on the lower back side and is a multi-function button. Other than lack of adjustability (my fault) it is a 5-star product.
